text:
I'm sorry, that's a stressful mix-up with the move coming up. Once an order has shipped, its address can't be changed, and couriers don't accept redirection requests from Leafy, so I can't redirect this one to your dad's place.

Express also isn't available for island addresses (Zone 3). If you place a new order to his address, it would go Standard, which takes 5-8 business days. Standard costs $7.95, or is free on orders of $75+ after discounts. Live plants only ship Monday to Wednesday, so an order placed after 12 noon on Wednesday ships the following Monday.

My policy info doesn't cover what happens to a mis-addressed parcel that's already on its way, such as whether it can be returned or re-sent. I can escalate that to a Support Lead if you'd like. If so, please send me the order number (LF- plus six digits).
